description: Mid-game (about 8-23 stones) positions where column 2 is either untouched or completely full, columns 0 and 4 are nearly empty (or col 4 full), column 5 is 2-4 high and column 6 is 2-3 high with my stone at its bottom and the opponent's stone on top. A partly filled column 2, especially with an opponent stone in it, switches it off. Near threshold it is diffuse; no single rule covers most firing.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero moves every column's probability by at most 0.02.
notes: Layer 1, looks like a distributed additive mix of column states. Minimal pairs: an opponent stone dropped into empty col 2 kills it (1.31 -> -0.1); filling col 2 completely raises it to 2.35-2.8; flipping col 6 colours (them under me) kills it. Single-feature rules failed (F1 0.09-0.15); a hand-weighted per-column points score built from firing-vs-nonfiring histograms reached F1 0.255 (P 0.39, R 0.19), AUROC 0.61, sim share 0.08. Synthesis beats dev max (2.82 vs 2.53). Possibly a random direction or mixture.
